hero.title: Your tax, employment and immigration partner.

intro.title: Landing in Canada is just the start.
intro.lede: Finding a family doctor. Decoding the CRA. Building credit. Enrolling kids in school. Reading an Ontario lease. Every step counts, and few people are there to guide you concretely, in your language.
intro.callout: The problem is navigation and accurate information, at the right time.

pillars.title: One place for your next steps.

pillars.p1_desc: T1, T2125 · First year in Canada · Newcomer credits · Catching up on past years.
pillars.p2_desc: Connecting you with bilingual employers in Ottawa. Submit your profile and we will put you in touch with our network of employers in the region.
pillars.p3_desc: Free 20-minute orientation session via Calendly. We work with OCISO and ACFO to direct you to the right resources for your status.

about_page.hero_title: Born from necessity, built for impact.
about_page.hero_lede: Andjix Consulting Inc. is an administrative, tax, and professional support firm based in Ottawa.
about_page.section1_title: A bilingual business, grounded in the Canadian system.
about_page.section1_p1: Andjix Consulting Inc. was founded in Ottawa by André Djomamessi. Training in administration and taxation, complemented by Canadian experience. Over a decade in the private sector: business management, tax compliance, recruitment.
about_page.section1_p2: Settled in Canada for several years, André knows the administrative system, federal institutions and the real needs of newcomers well.
about_page.p1_desc: Operational experience of Canadian administration. Deep working knowledge of federal and provincial institutions and their procedures.
about_page.p2_desc: Postgraduate diploma in tax (D.E.S.S.), complemented by Canadian training in business administration. Mastery of the CRA and Canadian tax obligations.
about_page.p3_desc: Knowledge of the Canadian job market: CV adaptation, interview coaching, employer-candidate matching and placement follow-up.
about_page.why_p: Because classic welcome services do valuable work, but cannot always offer individual follow-through, in your language, by someone who knows the system from the inside. Andjix fills that gap.
about_page.why_quote: One point of contact, from start to finish.
about_page.v1_desc: Your documents and data are protected to PIPEDA standards. See our privacy policy.
about_page.v2_desc: No hidden fees. You know what each service costs before we begin.
about_page.v3_desc: We also handle sliding-scale files for clients in financial hardship.
about_page.cta_lede: Start with Andjix AI, or book a session with an advisor directly.
